evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Story provides the creation capability for games, which is complemented by read, update, and delete stories elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators is a necessary step and is not missing any complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Viewing items is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection is supported by item creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list
evaluations.rationale: Provides the creation capability for items, which is complemented by read, update, and delete stories.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Editing is supported by item creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list
evaluations.rationale: Deletion is supported by item creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Estimate display is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting estimates is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically
evaluations.rationale: Automatic estimate acceptance is a complementary feature to manual acceptance.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of estimates is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is supported by item and estimate management stories.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories is a complementary way to create items, which is supported by item management stories.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is another method for item creation, complementing other item management stories.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is supported by game creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts is supported by game and estimate management stories.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts is a complementary feature to viewing and managing game data.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts in CSV is a complementary feature to HTML export and viewing.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Game deletion is supported by game creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is complemented by read, update, and delete stories for accounts.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is a necessary capability and is complemented by account management stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account update is supported by account creation and deletion stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is supported by account creation and update stories.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a complementary feature and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is a necessary feature and is complemented by account management stories.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting estimation scales is a configuration feature and does not expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Extends the invitation capability; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name
evaluations.rationale: Joining a game is supported by invitation and game management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Viewing items is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing all items is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Estimate tracking is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Estimate reveal is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Estimate modification is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Estimate tracking is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer
evaluations.rationale: Timer functionality is a complementary feature and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Timer reset is a complementary feature to timer start.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Reviewing prior rounds is supported by item and estimate management stories.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card order is a usability feature and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Estimate modification is supported by estimate creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail display is a complementary feature and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is a non-functional requirement and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary is a supporting feature and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexes are a technical feature and do not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility is a non-functional requirement and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility is a non-functional requirement and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance is a non-functional requirement and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a non-functional requirement and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL structure is a usability feature and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error pages are a usability feature and do not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymized storage is a data privacy feature and does not expose a missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics are a reporting feature and do not expose a missing capability.
